2981-3682-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2981-3682-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Mox Amber, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2403-3968-4050-4078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
2403-3968-4050-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Moonlit Wake triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

522-3967--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2185-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Bloodthrone Vampire abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2185-4247-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

4484-4871-6495-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4484-4871-6495-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Zombie Druid.
When the Zombie Druid dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-6495-6518.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

7084-7893-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1170-5131-6495-7729--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6495-7729--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Displacer Kitten and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-5131-6495-7729--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

687-4929-5641-5684-6261.notablePrerequisites: If Bulwark Ox is in your graveyard, you must have {3} available and three removable counters from creatures you control, ensuring to leave a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale. If Bulwark Ox is in your hand, you must have enough mana to cast it.
687-4929-5641-5684-6261.description:
Cast Bulwark Ox by paying its mana cost if it is in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Bulwark Ox from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Bulwark Ox enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale and a vigilance counter on Bulwark Ox.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both vigilance counters from Bulwark Ox and another counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Bulwark Ox by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Bulwark Ox from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Repeat.
687-4929-5641-5684-6261.notes: If you do not control any other creatures, you may instead activate Tayam before sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, thus using the Eldrazi Spawn's vigilance counter as the third counter for activation. Doing this will add {1} to the mana needed for the combo.

423-1437-3756-6628--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3756-6628--85.description:
Cast PuPu UFO by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the PuPu UFO spell three times.
Resolve the first PuPu UFO copy.
Activate the PuPu UFO's first ability by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

791-3693-5934-7186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
791-3693-5934-7186.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-2097-2307.description:
Activate Corsair Captain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Corsair Captain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Corsair Captain.
Resolve the Corsair Captain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1781-3814-6871.description:
Give the artifact type to Argothian Elder using Thran Forge.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat step 2.

3845-4771-5220-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1165-2861-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
1165-2861-6922.notablePrerequisites: Archfiend of the Dross has no more than four oil counters on it.
1165-2861-6922.description:
Cast Heartless Act by paying {1}{B}, removing up to three oil counters from Archfiend of the Dross.
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Archfiend of the Dross and causing you to draw a card.
At the beginning of the opponent's next upkeep, Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing the opponent to remove an oil counter from it and lose the game.

1170-3389-5921-5954-6763.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1912-2060-2445-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1912-2060-2445-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

1247-1597-5536.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness and has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Gyre Sage and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-1597-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Gyre Sage's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

467-549-1978-2713-4659.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
467-549-1978-2713-4659.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Shorikai.
Repeat.

877-1899-2232-3558.description:
Activate Beastcaller Savant by tapping it, adding {G} that can only be spent to cast a creature spell.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Beastcaller Savant to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Beastcaller Savant by paying {1} due to Morophon.
When Beastcaller Savant enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

57-1651-3685-4497-5051.notablePrerequisites: Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-1651-3685-4497-5051.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Slobad with haste that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
Activate the Slobad token by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding seven {R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying target permanent.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Traxos and Spine of Ish Sah, untapping the Slobad token.
Repeat from step 2.

1530-3293-3861.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
1530-3293-3861.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Play Orzhov Basilica from your hand.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Emeria Shepherd.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

2674-3554-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Personal Tutor and Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Cast Personal Tutor by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Seasons Past from your library.
Repeat.

802-1846-3198-3652.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Islands.
802-1846-3198-3652.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its Mutate cost by paying {U}{U}, targeting Ornithopter.
Lore Drakkis's mutate ability triggers, causing you to return Snap from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning the mutated creature that contains the nontoken Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two Islands.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.
